opportunities.name: Trip.com attraction search by destination, keyword and sort
opportunities.description: Search Trip.com Attractions & Tickets for a destination city and a keyword, then sort the results (Top Rated or Lowest Price) and open a listing.
steps: Open trip.com and click the 'Attractions & Tickets' tab.
Click the Destination field, type the city, and pick the matching suggestion.
Click the Keywords field, type the keyword, and pick a suggestion or leave the suggestion list.
On the results page, click the sort tab the user wants (for example 'Top Rated' or 'Lowest Price').
Open the top relevant listing to read its details and ticket price.
parameters: sort order (Top Rated or Lowest Price)

instances.values: Destination 'Hong Kong', keyword 'Park', sort 'Top Rated'; opened Shanghai Wild Animal Park listing at 160.3 (frames 12-18 region).
Destination 'Seoul', keyword 'amusement park', sort 'Lowest Price' (results page at 921.7).
Same Seoul / 'amusement park' results re-opened at 1033.5; opened 'Cerdon caves - Prehistoric Amusement Park' listing (From $18.94) at 1034.5.

opportunities.name: Qatar Airways baggage allowance lookup by cabin class
opportunities.description: Open the Qatar Airways Experience menu, go to Baggage allowance, and read the allowance for a chosen cabin class.
steps: Open the Qatar Airways home page.
On the baggage guide page, click the cabin tab for the wanted class (Economy Class, Business Class or First Class).
Read the allowance table for that class.

instances.values: Cabin class 'Economy Class' (Experience > Baggage allowance, then Economy tab).
Cabin class 'Business Class' (Experience > Baggage allowance, then Business tab), on the Stockholm flight-search page.

opportunities.name: KOA campground search by destination, dates and filters
opportunities.description: Search KOA for campgrounds near a destination with a check-in and check-out date and optional amenity filters such as RV Site, then submit with Find a KOA.
steps: Open koa.com and click 'Find a Campground'.
Optionally click 'Filters' and tick amenities such as 'RV Site' or 'Cabin'.
Click the 'Where do you want to go?' field, type the destination, and pick the suggestion.
Click the Check In field and pick the arrival date in the calendar, navigating months with the arrow if needed.
Click the Check Out field and pick the departure date.

instances.values: No destination entered; filter 'RV Site' ticked (Cabin not ticked), max distance 250; clicked Find a KOA.
Destination 'Lansing, MI, United States'; check-in 06/07/2023; check-out 06/12/2023 (calendar navigated from April to June/July 2023).
